LanguageData.SG_Rec1: No newcomers in the first 10 days, then at most one every 8 days.
LanguageData.SG_Rec2: The storyteller is only half as eager to send you people.
LanguageData.SG_Rec3: Wanderers and quests where someone joins wait; the stranger in black still comes when things go badly.
LanguageData.SG_Enabled_Desc: Master switch for the whole mod.
LanguageData.SG_FirstDay_Desc: Until this day of the game nobody joins through events – you get to survive on your own first.
LanguageData.SG_Between: At least this many days between newcomers: {0}
LanguageData.SG_Between_Desc: After somebody joins, the next newcomer from events can come only after this many days.
LanguageData.SG_Cap: No newcomers from events from: {0} colonists
LanguageData.SG_Cap_Desc: When the colony has this many colonists, events no longer bring new people. You can still recruit prisoners or rescue people yourself. 0 = no limit.
LanguageData.SG_Pop_Desc: Every storyteller wants a small colony to grow and sends people more often then. 100 % = like the game, 50 % = half as eager, 0 % = it never pushes growth on its own.
LanguageData.SG_Wanderers_Desc: The classic 'a wanderer wants to join' event and its versions from mods.
LanguageData.SG_Quests_Desc: Refugee pods, chased refugees, prisoners willing to join and every quest (also from mods) in which someone joins the colony.
LanguageData.SG_Creep_Desc: The strange people from Anomaly who ask to join.
LanguageData.SG_Stranger_Desc: He comes when the colony is in deep trouble. Off = he can still come any time (recommended for one-colonist starts).
LanguageData.SG_Recruits_Desc: When you recruit a prisoner, the waiting time for the next newcomer starts again. Recruiting itself is never blocked.
LanguageData.SG_StatusOpen: This game: {0} colonists – a newcomer can come now.
LanguageData.SG_WhyCap: the limit of {0} colonists is reached.
LanguageData.SG_ModJoiners_Desc: Events from other mods in which someone joins. The mod recognises them by name, and any event that brings a new colonist is remembered and waits from then on. The list below shows them all – untick one to let it through.
LanguageData.SG_ListHead: Events that bring new colonists ({0}) – ticked = waits
